question: Should the official `memory-lancedb` plugin add opt-in hybrid recall, or should users needing hybrid retrieval continue using the separately maintained community plugin?
rationale: Existing OpenClaw plugin seams and LanceDB APIs support either direction, while default retrieval semantics and new configuration are public product contracts that source evidence cannot choose automatically.

options.title: Sponsor minimal official parity
options.body: Add one opt-in hybrid setting using LanceDB RRF defaults, preserve vector-only behavior and duplicate detection, and defer weight controls until real usage demonstrates a need.

options.title: Keep hybrid community-owned
options.body: Leave the official plugin vector-only, correct its README wording, and document the maintained external plugin for advanced hybrid and reranking workflows.

recommendation.title: Sponsor minimal official parity
recommendation.body: Add one opt-in hybrid setting using LanceDB RRF defaults, preserve vector-only behavior and duplicate detection, and defer weight controls until real usage demonstrates a need.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the prior scope distinction, has repository admin permission, and has the strongest recent ownership trail in this plugin.
